title: NEBNext® Small RNA Library Prep for Illumina® Protocol
author: New England Biolabs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.t7qermw
materials: NEBNext® Small RNA Library Prep Set

steps.title: Prepare 3´ SR Adaptor
steps.instruction: Dilute the (green) 3´ SR Adaptor for Illumina based on total RNA input.

substeps.instruction: For 100 ng total RNA: dilute adaptor 1:2 in nuclease-free water (e.g., 1 µl adaptor and 1 µl water).
For inputs closer to 1 µg: do not dilute the adaptor.

steps.title: Perform 3´ Ligation
steps.instruction: Mix the required components in a sterile nuclease-free PCR tube and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in a preheated thermal cycler for 00:02:00 at 70 °C.
Transfer tube to ice.

steps.title: Ligate 3´ Adaptor
steps.instruction: Add and mix the ligation components and incubate in a thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 01:00:00 at 25 °C.
Note: For methylated RNAs (e.g., piRNAs), incubation can be extended to 18:00:00 at 16 °C to increase efficiency, though concatamerization may occur.

steps.title: Prepare SR RT Primer
steps.instruction: Dilute the (pink) SR RT Primer for Illumina based on total RNA input.

substeps.instruction: For 100 ng total RNA: dilute primer 1:2 in nuclease-free water.
For inputs closer to 1 µg: do not dilute the primer.

steps.title: Block Adaptor-Dimer Formation
steps.instruction: Add and mix the primer components into the ligation mixture from Step 4 and run the thermal cycler program.

substeps.instruction: Set heated lid to > 85 °C.
Run program: 5 minutes at 75 °C, 15 minutes at 37 °C, 15 minutes at 25 °C, then hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 5´ SR Adaptor
steps.instruction: Resuspend and denature the (yellow) 5´ SR adaptor.

substeps.instruction: With 00:05:00 remaining in the previous cycle, resuspend the (yellow) 5´ SR adaptor in 120 µL nuclease-free water.
For inputs closer to 100 ng: additionally dilute the adaptor 1:2 in nuclease-free water.
For inputs closer to 1 µg: do not dilute further.
Aliquot the adaptor into separate nuclease-free 200 µl PCR tubes (number of samples + 10% excess).
Incubate aliquots in thermal cycler at 70 °C for 00:02:00, then immediately place on ice.
Use denatured adaptor within 00:30:00; store remaining resuspended adaptor at -80 °C.

steps.title: Perform 5´ Ligation
steps.instruction: Add and mix the 5´ SR adaptor components into the ligation mixture from Step 7 (do not premix reagents) and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 01:00:00 at 25 °C in a thermal cycler.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription (RT)
steps.instruction: Mix RT components in a sterile, nuclease-free tube and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 01:00:00 at 50 °C.
Optional: If not proceeding immediately to PCR, heat inactivate at 70 °C for 00:15:00 and store at -15 °C to -25 °C.

steps.title: PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Add PCR components (including one of the 1-48 index primers) to the RT reaction mix and amplify.

substeps.instruction: For 100 ng total RNA: run 15 PCR cycles.
For 1 µg total RNA (human brain optimization): run 12 PCR cycles.
For high small RNA amounts: use < 12 cycles.
Safe Stopping Point: Store library at -20 °C after PCR.

steps.title: Initial PCR Cleanup
steps.instruction: Purify the 100 µL PCR amplified cDNA construct using a Monarch PCR & DNA Kit.

substeps.instruction: Use a 7:1 ratio of binding buffer to sample.
Discard flow through after each centrifugation.
Elute amplified DNA in 27.5 µL (or 32 µL depending on subsequent size selection option) nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Library Quality Control
steps.instruction: Check the purified PCR reaction on a Bioanalyzer.

substeps.instruction: Load 1 µL of purified PCR reaction on a DNA 1000 chip.
Verify miRNA library peak at 147 bp.

steps.title: Size Selection (Choose Option A, B, or C)
steps.instruction: Select the appropriate method based on Bioanalyzer QC results.

steps.title: Option A: PAGE Gel Size Selection
steps.instruction: Isolate specific RNA fragments using a 6% PolyAcrylamide Gel.

substeps.instruction: Mix 25 µL purified PCR product with 5 µL Gel Loading Dye, Blue (6X).
Load 5 µL Quick-Load pBR322 DNA-MspI Digest in one well; load two wells with 15 µL each of the mixed cDNA construct.
Run gel for 01:00:00 at 120 V (stop before blue dye exits gel).
Stain with SYBR Gold for 00:02:00–00:03:00 and view on UV transilluminator.
Isolate bands: ~140 bp for miRNAs, ~150 bp for piRNAs.
Crush two gel slices from the same sample in a 1.5 ml tube using RNase-free Disposable Pellet Pestles and soak in 250 µL DNA Gel Elution buffer (1X).
Rotate end-to-end for at least 02:00:00 at room temperature.
Transfer eluate and debris to a gel filtration column (e.g., Spin-X) and centrifuge for 00:02:00 at > 13,200 rpm.
Recover eluate and add 1 µL Linear Acrylamide, 25 µL 3M sodium acetate (pH 5.5), and 750 µL 100% ethanol; vortex well.
Precipitate in dry ice/methanol bath or at -80 °C for at least 00:30:00.
Spin in microcentrifuge at > 14,000 x g for 00:30:00 at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant, wash pellet with 80% ethanol via vigorous vortexing, and spin again at > 14,000 x g for 00:30:00 at 4 °C.
Air dry pellet for up to 00:10:00 at room temperature.
Resuspend pellet in 12 µL TE Buffer.
QC: Load 1 µL on Bioanalyzer (DNA 1000 or High Sensitivity chip).

steps.title: Option B: Pippin Prep Size Selection
steps.instruction: Perform automated size selection using the Pippin Prep instrument.

substeps.instruction: In Protocol Editor, select 'Cassette' folder -> '3% DF Marker P'.
Set collection mode to 'Range': BP start (105), BP end (155), Range Flag 'broad'.
Enable 'Use of Internal Standards' and verify 'Ref Lane' values.
Combine 30 µL sample with 10 µL DNA marker P, vortex, and briefly centrifuge.
Load 40 µL (DNA plus marker) on one well of the 3% agarose cassette and run program.
Collect 40 µL sample from elution well.
QC: Run 1 µL on Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity chip.

steps.title: Option C: AMPure XP Bead Size Selection
steps.instruction: Use double-sided bead purification to remove fragments > 150 bp.

substeps.instruction: Add 32.5 µL (1.3X) resuspended AMPure XP beads to 25 µL purified PCR reaction; mix and incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand; after 00:05:00, transfer 57.5 µL supernatant to a new tube and discard beads.
Add 92.5 µL (3.7X) resuspended AMPure XP beads to the supernatant; mix and incubate for 00:05:00 at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand; after 00:05:00, discard supernatant and keep beads.
Wash beads twice: add 200 µL 80% ethanol, incubate 00:00:30, and discard supernatant.
Briefly spin, return to magnetic stand, and air dry beads for up to 00:10:00 (do not overdry).
Elute DNA with 15 µL nuclease-free water; mix, incubate for 00:02:00, and clear on magnetic stand.
Transfer supernatant to a clean PCR tube.
QC: Run 1 µL on Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity chip.
